records.notes: Editions compared (all opened as PDF from s7d2.scene7.com): DS60PG/0320 (2020, newest data sheet, CM20150703-52095-49890): 5670 kWe, 11 430 kJ/kWe-hr, 'Exhaust Flow 78 370 kg/hr (172,770 lb/hr)', 510 C (950 F), PR 12.2:1, airflow 21.5 kg/s, 'Engine efficiency: 31.5% (measured at generator terminals)', 'Package Height: 3.2 m (10' 5")', 'Package Weight: 37 920 kg (83,600 lb) Dry weight, enclosed height', drawing 9.8 m x 2.6 m. DS60PG/0113 (2013, C10550195; Spanish C10574563): same power/HR/temp, exhaust 78 385 kg/hr (172,810 lb/hr), PR 12.4:1, 'Package Weight: 39 100 kg (86,100 lb)'. DS60GS/1109 (2009, O&G, C10550197; Spanish C10574566): 5670 kWe, 78 385 kg/hr, PR 12.2:1, airflow 21.6 kg/s, 'Max. Speed: 14,950', 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 'Typical Weight: 39 055 kg (87,160 lb)' (kg and lb disagree: 39 055 kg = 86,100 lb). Handbook BPGPH/0525 (2025): 5.7 MW, 11,430 kJ/kWe-hr, 31.5 %, 21.8 kg/s (48.0 lb/s), 510 C (951 F), package 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 37,920 kg / 83,600 lb, footnote 'Dry weight, unenclosed height and weight' (DS60PG/0320 says 'enclosed height' for the same 3.2 m / 37 920 kg). BIL/0622 (2022) and BPGPSG/116 (2016): 5670 kWe, 31.5 %, 9.8 x 2.6 x 3.2 m, 37 920 kg. Older: BIL/512 (2012) 30.4 %, 39 055 kg; BO&G/811 (2011) 'APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS (unenclosed)' 9.8 x 2.4 x 2.8 m, 30 300 kg; Turbomach BPHBTBM/512 (2012) 5.67 MW, 11'427 kJ/kWh, 31.50 %, 'Exhaust gas flow: kg/s 21.77', 510 C, T 7901, L 10.0 W 2.2 H 6.6 m, 45 t incl. filter system (outdoor). Manufacturer product page (solarturbines.com) not openable: curl HTTP 403 Akamai 'Access Denied' at 17:5x and 18:01 UTC, WebFetch DNS not resolved; its values known only from search-index extracts (5670 kWe, 10,830 Btu/kWh, 172,810 lb/h = 78 385 kg/h, 950 F / 510 C), identical to DS60PG/0113. Taken: power 5670 kWe, HR 11 430, 510 C, efficiency 31.5 % (PUBLISHED; 3600/11430 = 31.50 agrees). Exhaust flow: exh_flow_kg_h kept 78 385 (current product page extract + DS60PG/0113 + DS60GS/1109 + BO&G/811); newest PDF DS60PG/0320 prints 78 370 kg/hr - both give 21.77 kg/s, which Turbomach publishes directly. PR changed 12.4 -> 12.2: newest sheet DS60PG/0320 and O&G sheet DS60GS/1109 print 12.2:1; 12.4:1 only in DS60PG/0113 (the earlier 12.4 came from etn.global). out_rpm changed 14944 -> 14950 max: 14,944/14,951 came from a globalpwr.com cut sheet (not an allowed host, not opened); the only Solar figure is the turbine maximum 'Max. Speed: 14,950' (DS60GS/1109; unit not printed). pkg L/W/H/kg values unchanged (9.8/2.6/3.2 m, 37 920 kg), source moved from etn.global to Solar DS60PG/0320 + BPGPH/0525. No Taurus 60 generator-set Turbomachinery Package Specification on allowed hosts (manualsdir has only TPS60CSMD/309 for compressor set/mechanical drive), so engine mass/size, starter kW, fuel gas pressure, lube volumes, bleed valves and engine change time remain unverified for GS; the two-shaft MD engine figures (3290 kg, 56 kW starter, 1170-2068 kPag fuel) are NOT transferred to the single-shaft GS engine.

records.notes: Editions compared (opened): DS60MD/713 (2013, mechanical drive, C10550209; Spanish C10574565), DS60CS/1109 (2009, compressor set, C10550246; Spanish C10574549) - identical: 5740 kW (7700 hp), 11 265 kJ/kW-hr (7965 Btu/hp-hr), 77 880 kg/hr (171,690 lb/hr), 510 C (950 F), PR 12.2:1, airflow 21.3 kg/s, GP 2-stage reaction 'Max. Speed: 15,000 rpm', PT 2-stage reaction 'Max. Speed: 14,300 rpm', 'Engine efficiency: 32%', driver package 6.0 x 2.5 x 2.7 m, 'Typical Weight: 15 420 kg (34,000 lb)' ('*Driver package only' on DS60CS). Turbomachinery Package Specification TPS60CSMD/309 (2009, Solar, read page by page at manualsdir.com, all 83 pages fetched): same performance (heat rate printed '(7960 Btu/ kW-hr)' - unit misprint for Btu/hp-hr), PR '12.2:1 (Compressor Set)' / '11.5:1 (Mechanical Drive)', flow 21.3 / 21.1 kg/s, Table 1 package dimensions and weights, systems data. BIL/0622 (2022): 5740 kW, 7700 hp, 32.0 %, 6.0 x 2.5 x 2.7 m, 15 420 kg; BIL/512 (2012): 31.9 %, same dims; BO&G/811 (2011) 'APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS (unenclosed)' 6.2 x 2.5 x 2.7 m, 15 880 kg (35,000 lb). Manufacturer product page not openable (curl HTTP 403 Akamai twice >30 s apart, WebFetch DNS not resolved); search-index extract values (7700 hp, 5740 kW, 7965 Btu/hp-hr, 171,690 lb/h, 950 F) equal DS60MD/713. eff_pct 32.0 is PUBLISHED ('Engine efficiency: 32%'); 3600/11265 = 31.96 agrees. exh_flow_kg_s = 77 880 kg/hr / 3600 (unit conversion). PR kept 12.2 (MD data sheet DS60MD/713, newer than the TPS) but TPS gives 11.5:1 for the mechanical-drive rating - conflict to confirm with Solar. Package dimensions/weight taken from the package specification (priority for dimensions): L 6.02, W 2.46 (to skid edges; 2.59 with lifting bollards), H 2.72 unenclosed (3.20 enclosed), 15 422 kg unenclosed without oil (20 607 kg enclosed with oil) - same as the data-sheet roundings 6.0/2.5/2.7 m / 15 420 kg. engine_kg 3290 = 'Gas Turbine Assembly (SoLoNOx)'. out_rpm: only maxima are published (PT 14,300, GP 15,000 rpm); nominal PT speed and speed range not published. Earlier sources for PR/stages/speeds/dimensions pointed to the compressor-set sheet C10550246; now the mechanical-drive sheet C10550209 and the TPS. Skeptic check 14.11.2026: bearing count left UNRESOLVED - TPS Table 2 says 3 radial + 1 thrust, TPS Table 10 lists bearings #1-#5 and separate GP and PT thrust bearings.
